headline_claims: Announced as first open-weight world action model, built on Runway video pretraining; weights NOT downloadable yet, early partners (Noble Machines, Standard Bots, Ultra) running it on own hardware. Vendor figure 2 final placement error after finetuning (lower is better): 16.1 cm web video from scratch, 16.0 cm teleop robot video from scratch. Sim-to-real correlation 0.95 for policy evaluation in the world model.
quote: Today we're announcing Praxis-1, our first open-weight world action model.

role_in_robotics: data generation / policy pretraining / planning / evaluation
headline_claims: Vendor ranking, no numbers given: among open models it ranks first across Artificial Analysis, Physics-IQ, PAI-Bench and R-Bench. Unified omnimodel (text, image, video, ambient sound, actions) on a Mixture-of-Transformers with Reasoner and Generator towers. GitHub lists Super 64B, Nano 16B, Edge 4B; Edge marked coming soon in the press release. Predecessor Predict/Transfer/Reason repos still listed on GitHub.
quote: TAIPEI, Taiwan, June 01, 2026 ... NVIDIA today launched NVIDIA Cosmos 3, an open world foundation model for physical AI

headline_claims: Unified world action model jointly modelling video and action (UniDiffuser formulation, three-stream Mixture-of-Transformers). Abstract: 95.8% clean and 96.1% randomized average success on RoboTwin 2.0; strongest reported EWMScore on WorldArena (no number in abstract; press reports 63.77, unverified in paper). Weight release status not verified.
quote: Motubrain achieves 95.8% and 96.1% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 under clean and randomized settings, respectively

headline_claims: Video-model-based world model for NEO home humanoid: generates visualisations of future actions from the robot camera and a prompt, then a built-in inverse dynamics model turns them into motor commands. Company claims novel tasks (toilet seat operation) with no prior examples in dataset; no success-rate or benchmark numbers published. Early Access $20,000; $499/month subscription.
quote: 1X is excited to announce the new 1X World Model, a groundbreaking AI update for NEO

developer: ROBOTERA (Star Motion Era, 星动纪元)
headline_claims: Vendor press release: ranked first on RoboDojo (HKU MMLab benchmark, about 20 institutions) with 32.26% average success rate and 39.26 average score, without extra data or agent self-improvement; 58.5% average success across 10 task categories on ALOHA, beating leading baselines in 9. Open-sourced on GitHub per release (repo URL not confirmed). Third-party analysis notes the VPP2 paper itself describes large-scale video pretraining.
quote: VPP2 achieved an average success rate of 32.26% and an average score of 39.26,

headline_claims: Tactile-grounded world model for force, friction, deformation and slippage; claims to unify physical cognition, predictive decision making and real-time control. Public debut at IROS 2026. Launch date disputed in trade press (Aug 10 vs Aug 13, 2026; user-supplied 2026-09-29 is a news-article date). No independent benchmark found; performance claims are company-reported.
quote: IROS 2026: Daimon Robotics showcases tactile intelligence infrastructure for physical AI

headline_claims: Open-source simulator with rendering engine Nyx and GPU compute layer Quadrants (forked from Taichi). Company claim: one hour of real-world testing equals 100 days in simulation (unverified). Earlier Genesis release (Dec 2024) cited speed of up to 43 million frames per second. HQ country not confirmed from a primary source.
quote: Genesis AI open-sources Genesis World 1.0 simulation platform for robotics

model: General Intuition world model (MIRA and gym)
headline_claims: Seed launch with 134M; trains agents on gameplay video (2B videos a year from Medal). Public playable demo MIRA (with Kyutai and Epic Games) trained on 10,000 hours of Rocket League, 20 fps. Company reports adapting the same model to a quadruped robot with 8 minutes of real-world robotics data. Robotics is a secondary application; the agent, not the world model, is the product. Later $300M raise reported but unverified.
quote: General Intuition lands $134M seed to teach agents spatial reasoning using video game clips

headline_claims: Interactive world model for physical AI, API-accessible, generating action-responsive simulation for robot learning, starting with autonomous vehicles. Company claims sub-40 ms latency and up to 1,000x faster than industry standards (unverified, vendor-reported). Runs on DOS 2.0 inference stack. Sources disagree on Decart round size label.
quote: How Decart built Oasis 3, the first API-accessible world model for faster, more effective, and scalable robotic learning

headline_claims: Pretrained checkpoints evaluated without per-task fine-tuning on 100 tasks across 20 manipulation skill groups. Scaling co-training data from 300 to 30,000 hours raises success from 17.1% to 44.1% on G1-OP and from 13.4% to 31.1% on G2-90D. G2-90D gains 17.7 points with under 2% of co-training data. Skill-specific coverage correlates with zero-shot OOD success (Pearson r=0.80). Release status of weights not verified.
quote: Scaling co-training data from 300 to 30,000 hours raises success from 17.1% to 44.1% on G1-OP

headline_claims: Foundation world model learning dexterous controls from 44k hours of egocentric human video; distillation to a real-time 10.81 FPS. Abstract names 'multiple challenging out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks' without naming them or giving scores. Code/weights release not stated on the abstract page (HF repo nvidia/DreamDojo exists per search).
quote: a foundation world model that learns diverse interactions and dexterous controls from 44k hours of egocentric human videos

headline_claims: Open-sourced multimodal 3D world model taking text, single image, multi-view images or video and producing persistent 3D worlds exported as meshes, Gaussian splats and point clouds for simulation pipelines. Tencent claims comparable to closed World Labs Marble (vendor claim). Robotics is an output use case, not a robot-specific benchmark. Release date differs by a day across sources.
quote: Tencent Open-Sources HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal 3D World Model

headline_claims: Positioned as a closed-loop robot video world simulator, moving from world action models toward interactive world simulators for training and evaluating robots. Chinese reprint reports first place overall in the CVPR 2026 WorldArena world-model track (not confirmed against the official leaderboard). Release/weights not verified; the GE-Act 2.0 paper relationship to GE 2.0 is unclear.
quote: 在近期公布的CVPR 2026 WorldArena世界模型赛道评测中,智元(Agibot)自研的Genie Envisioner 2.0(GE 2.0)获得总分第一。

headline_claims: 15B-parameter generative world model for autonomous-driving validation, framed as offline evaluation pipeline that generates, simulates and scores counterfactual scenarios. Secondary reports: trained on 10x the data of GAIA-2; fivefold drop in synthetic test sequences rejected as unrealistic (company-reported via aggregator). Not a robot model; included as adjacent evaluation world model.
quote: wayve unveils gaia 3 for autonomous driving tests

headline_claims: Language-driven video world model forecasting scene change after an action, trained on 8.6 million video-text pairs and more than 200 million frames across 20+ robot platforms (company figures). Suite also has Qwen-RobotManip, reported 45% task success and process score 59.83 on RoboChallenge generalist track (company-reported). In pilot with selected Alibaba Cloud enterprise customers; not broadly available.
quote: Alibaba unveils Qwen robot suite for navigation, manipulation and world modeling

headline_claims: Multimodal world model that builds 3D environments from images, video or text; first commercial product with paid plans up to $95/month (secondary report). AMD agreed to acquire World Labs for about $8.2B in all-stock deal, closing expected end of 2026 (secondary reports, conflicting detail on payment form). No robotics benchmark found; Atlas (newer model) early access only.
quote: AMD rachète World Labs et ses « modèles de monde » pour 8,2 milliards de dollars

developer: X Square Robot (自变量机器人)
headline_claims: Embodied foundation model built on a World Unified Model architecture that jointly trains vision, language, action, tactile and physical prediction in one network (company framing). Company also open-sourced WALL-OSS and Wall-OSS-0.5 models and training code (weights status of WALL-B itself not verified). Company-reported logistics demo at WRC 2026: 1,816 parcels per hour, over 98% accuracy.
quote: In April 2026, the company introduced WALL-B, an embodied AI foundation model built on its World Unified Model architecture.
